scenario_description: A grocery distributor opens a supervisor operations walkthrough that closely matches Lena's goal of becoming an operations manager, but it overlaps the first part of her confirmed evening shift. The initial mention is too uncertain for useful intervention because there is no date or confirmed seat. Once the date and nomination deadline arrive, the opportunity and schedule conflict are sufficiently observable before the final Event. Sam later offers a workable shift exchange, while Greg confirms that he can nominate Lena if coverage is arranged. Proactively connecting the calendar conflict, Sam's availability, and Greg's nomination process could secure Lena a valuable development opportunity without leaving the store short-staffed.

parameter.subject: Possible distributor operations walkthrough
parameter.body: Cascadia Grocery Distribution is considering a small behind-the-scenes walkthrough for supervisors from independent stores. They have not confirmed the date, available seats, or agenda yet. I will pass along the details if they open it to Riverbend.

parameter.subject: Supervisor operations walkthrough confirmed for May 5
parameter.body: Riverbend Market may nominate one supervisor for our operations walkthrough on Tuesday, May 5, from 3:00 to 5:00 PM at the Cascadia distribution center. The session will cover delivery receiving, stock flow, shift handoffs, and daily operations planning. Please send the nominee's name by April 15.

parameter.content: I need to move my Thursday, May 7 daytime supervisor shift for a family event. I could cover the supervisor floor duties from 2:00 to 6:00 PM on Tuesday, May 5 if you are open to taking my May 7 shift instead.

parameter.subject: May 5 walkthrough nomination
parameter.body: The Cascadia walkthrough would be useful preparation for someone interested in broader store operations. I am willing to nominate you, but Riverbend needs qualified supervisor coverage for the start of your May 5 shift. Let me know if you can arrange coverage and I will submit your name.

parameter.content: My offer to exchange coverage on May 5 and May 7 is still open. I need to finalize my own schedule by noon tomorrow, so please confirm with me and Greg before then if you want to make the swap.

parameter.name: Sam Rivera
parameter.notes: Qualified to cover store supervisor floor duties.

parameter.title: Evening supervisor shift - May 5
parameter.description: Lena's confirmed evening supervisor shift at Riverbend Market.

parameter.description: Sam Rivera's daytime supervisor shift that he is available to exchange with Lena.
